summary: Accepted the Terafab-to-TSMC relationship as a positive bridge beneficiary with medium sensitivity and medium confidence. SpaceX expects significant third-party compute sourcing to continue while internal capability develops, preserving leading-node and advanced-packaging demand. The edge explicitly reverses if qualified Terafab insourcing displaces more TSMC volume than the ramp creates; no strategy or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: SpaceX expects significant third-party compute sourcing to continue during the internal Terafab buildout.
Nvidia identifies dependence on external foundry, memory and packaging partners including TSMC, linking current Nvidia-led demand to TSMC production.
TSMC's annual report supports leading-node, advanced-packaging and manufacturing-scale capability but not a Terafab-specific contract.

daily_report_items: Accepted TSMC as a medium-sensitivity Terafab bridge beneficiary while making qualified long-run insourcing the explicit reversal condition.
